fixtures.preview: A badly timed trip to fifth-placed Chelsea, six days after a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth left United 16th and Michael Carrick's future in doubt (11:30pm Sat 31 Oct Sydney).
talking_points: United sit 16th on 7 points, one above the drop zone, after the Bournemouth loss, which followed a 4-1 defeat at Como in the Champions League.
Carrick said he doesn't know what happens next; reports say his job is at risk, but no club decision had been reported at the time of writing.
Bruno Fernandes was dropped against Bournemouth after criticising the tactics, and Lisandro Martínez was reportedly fined for an incident with director of football Jason Wilcox.
Chelsea are fifth on 13 points but lost 2-0 at home to Tottenham on Saturday; team news for both sides isn't confirmed yet.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford (7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney).
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Villa, who beat Manchester City 2-1 on Saturday.
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time, live on Sky Sports in the UK.
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
A 5pm Halloween game in round 3 at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's home opener, with Sydney fresh from a comeback win over Adelaide.
talking_points: Sydney came from behind to beat Adelaide United 2-1 on Sunday, with Rhys Youlley and Oriola Sunday scoring their first A-League goals.
That followed a 0-0 draw with Western Sydney in round 1.
City are still winless after two games, including a 1-1 Melbourne Derby, and the club is billing this as a family Halloween outing.
Last season City won in Sydney through a Max Caputo header after a 0-0 draw at AAMI Park; team news for this game isn't published yet.

fixtures.preview: A Friday-night home game against the Mariners.

big_matches.title: Barcelona v Real Madrid (El Clásico)
big_matches.why: First Clásico of the season at Camp Nou, with unbeaten Barcelona six points clear of third-placed Madrid (7am Mon 26 Oct Sydney).
talking_points: Barcelona have won all nine LaLiga games; Madrid are third, six points back, and last lost in their most recent league match.
Vinícius Júnior is suspended for Madrid, so Kylian Mbappé is expected to lead the attack.
Barcelona are without Dani Olmo, Jules Koundé, Andreas Christensen and Eric García.
It's José Mourinho's first Clásico since returning to Madrid, against Hansi Flick.

big_matches.title: Liverpool v Arsenal

talking_points: Arsenal are level on 21 points with leaders Manchester City after beating Everton 2-0 on Saturday.
Liverpool are fourth on 15 points after a 2-0 win over Brighton on Sunday.

notes: Search quality was poor this run: many sites (BBC, Guardian, manutd.com, footballwebpages) blocked access, and fresh news searches often returned old seasons. Several sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: the 0-3 Bournemouth result and league position come from Sky Sports and NBC Sports; reports on Carrick's future are unconfirmed and could change before the Chelsea game. I found no confirmed team news for Chelsea. The Sporting CP date and time are from UEFA's fixture list, and the Lisbon venue is from fixture sites, not UEFA.

Sydney FC: the 2-1 win over Adelaide comes from the club's news index, and I couldn't open a full match report. Paramount+ is named as an A-Leagues partner, but per-match broadcasters aren't published; the Auckland game's 5pm start is treated as NZ time and there may be another round between 21 Nov and 6 Dec that I couldn't find.

Big matches: Stan Sport is listed as the Champions League broadcaster and for all three Wallabies November Tests; beIN lists the Clásico, which kicks off at 7am Monday Sydney time. I couldn't confirm an Australian broadcaster for the F1 or the ATP Finals, so they're left out. I found no confirmed talking points for Atlético v Bayern or England v Wallabies.
Live sport: no rugby union, tennis or Matildas/Socceroos games in Sydney in the next 4 weeks were found. Kings v Phoenix has no published start time.

Local: school events come from the downloaded Term 4 calendars and Week 2 updates; nothing was found for the other school. No current South Eveleigh events page could be opened. Tenjo is older than 7 days but kept for its planned November opening.

Not found: matcha pop-ups in Sydney, junior parkrun or kids' fun runs near home, Pokémon/Minecraft/Roblox events, children's author talks, kids' craft workshops in November, and confirmed sports-gear sales (Rebel's boots sale ended 11 Oct). Black Friday is Fri 27 Nov, just outside the window, with some early sales from about 23 Nov.

Groceries: Woolworths and Coles half-price lists weren't accessible, so most items have no was-price and there are no fresh fruit, meat or egg specials. Aldi's new-week specials start Wed 28 Oct; the other Woolworths and Coles items end Tue 27 Oct.
Horizon: all entries were re-checked this run; the Sydney Marathon was added, and ballot-result dates differ between sources (29 Oct vs 3 Nov).
